fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.description: Dashboard chat alias (Validate). Required by the form. The decisions model is not a chat model — use any alias your key can reach that passes Validate (e.g. private-large). For engine=http the API model is model_alpha.

fields.name: model_alpha
fields.label: Decisions model
fields.description: Model id for engine=http, sent to POST {base_url}/v1/decisions. If the dashboard does not pass this field, run.sh defaults to xor-latest (not the chat model).

fields.name: base_url
fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Server origin. Trailing /v1 or /v1/decisions is stripped. engine=http: decisions origin (POST /v1/decisions). engine=grid: /v1 is appended for chat completions.

fields.name: engine
fields.label: Engine
fields.description: http: POST /v1/decisions (default). grid: chat completions. random: pipeline check.

fields.name: task_range
fields.label: Task range
fields.description: Inclusive row indices. Use 0-9 for the first dashboard smoke (Runbook A §14.1). Leave empty for the full suite (~150k rows).

fields.name: delay_s
fields.label: Pause after each request (seconds)
fields.description: Pause after each request, per parallel worker. 0 = no pause; use concurrency to set throughput.

fields.name: concurrency
fields.label: Parallel requests
fields.description: Requests in flight at once (1-20). 20 finishes the full suite in about 1.2h at ~570ms latency (set Runtime to 3h); lower it if the server or key cannot take the load. HTTP 429/502/503/504 are retried 3 times with backoff.

fields.name: resume
fields.label: Resume
fields.description: Keep partial results.jsonl in the run directory. Use false for the first smoke run.
